titles: Fell Through the Ice? You Have 1-10-1 Minutes. Don't Run.
1, 10, 1: The Cold Water Rule That Saved My Brother
Why You Must Never Run to Someone Who Fell Through Ice
description: My brother fell through the ice and I was forty meters away. The cold water 1-10-1 rule (one minute to breathe, ten minutes of useful strength, one hour before passing out) gave me time to do it right: call, reach, and never go in after him. Part two covers the hour after. Check the 1-10-1 figures against the source organization before posting. #survival #icesafety #coldwater #shorts #safetytips
